These are the chart values that carry credentials. Keep them out of your
cluster's values file: copy `secrets.values.example.yaml` to
`secrets.values.yaml`, fill in the values you use, and pass both files to
`helm`. **Always** means the example file sets the key live with a `<YOUR_*>`
placeholder; the others are commented out until the feature their description
names is in use.

| Value | Needed | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `global.ingress.certificateTLSCrt` | If used | TLS certificate in plain PEM format. Used when createCertificateSecret is true. Base64-encoded automatically by the chart. |
| `global.ingress.certificateTLSKey` | If used | TLS private key in plain PEM format. Used when createCertificateSecret is true. Base64-encoded automatically by the chart. |
| `global.gateway.tls.certificateTLSCrt` | If used | PEM certificate (plain text; chart base64-encodes). Pass via --set-file on upgrade. |
| `global.gateway.tls.certificateTLSKey` | If used | PEM private key (plain text; chart base64-encodes). Pass via --set-file on upgrade. |
| `global.rabbitmqPassword` | If used | RabbitMQ password inlined into the KEDA AMQP URI (required when a RabbitMQ-scaled subchart runs with keda.enabled and global.kedaRabbitmqAuth.existingSecret is empty). Must match common.secrets.rabbitmqPassword and rabbitmq.auth.password. Leave empty when using global.kedaRabbitmqAuth.existingSecret instead. |
| `common.secrets.dockerConfigJson` | Always | Base64-encoded Docker Hub .dockerconfigjson. |
| `common.secrets.dbConnectionString` | Always | Database connection string (DocumentDB / Cosmos DB / MongoDB Atlas). |
| `common.secrets.kafkaPassword` | If used | Kafka SASL password. |
| `common.secrets.rabbitmqPassword` | Always | RabbitMQ password. |
| `common.secrets.kaggleApiToken` | If used | Kaggle API token for agents_handler public-dataset search/download. Optional: the agents_handler image already ships SpecificAI's token, and this value only needs setting to override it with your own Kaggle account. |
| `common.secrets.supervisorAdminToken` | If used | Token guarding the Playground inference supervisor's admin endpoints. Leave empty: the chart generates one on first install and keeps it across upgrades. Set it only to pin a value. |
| `common.optune_auth.web_app_okta_client_secret` | If used | Okta OIDC client secret. Empty by default; required only when method is OKTA. |
| `common.optune_auth.web_app_google_client_secret` | If used | Google OAuth client secret. Required only when single sign-on uses Google. |
| `common.optune_auth.web_app_azure_client_secret` | If used | Microsoft Entra ID application client secret. Required only when single sign-on uses Entra ID. |
| `common.coralogix.secret.privateKey` | Always | Coralogix private key (send logs/metrics). |
| `backend.storage.blob.accountKey` | If used | Storage account key. Legacy shared-key path only: read when `global.azure.useWorkloadIdentityForBlob` is false. Azure only. |
| `rabbitmq.auth.password` | Always | Password of the in-cluster RabbitMQ user. Must match `common.secrets.rabbitmqPassword`. |
| `rabbitmq.auth.erlangCookie` | If used | Erlang cookie of the in-cluster RabbitMQ. Leave empty to let the RabbitMQ chart generate one. |
| `mongodb.auth.rootPassword` | If used | Root password of the in-cluster MongoDB. Only when `mongodb.enabled` is true. |
| `mongodb.auth.passwords` | If used | Passwords of the in-cluster MongoDB users, one per entry in `usernames`. Only when `mongodb.enabled` is true. |
